detail.longDescription: An industry poised to produce significant social good would not exhibit evidence it's operating according to Hotelling's law as intensely as the AI industry does, in my opinion. Among the many things wrong with this industry is that there's little differentiation among the core players, suggesting they are significantly more motivated by corporate-level pressures than they are motivated to produce anything of value to society. Which has been clear for awhile, but Hotelling's law points to where this can lead. #AI #GenAI #GenerativeAI #AgenticAI #agents #chatbots #LLMs #OpenAI #Anthropic
